item.title: Mount Misen: Miyajima's Sacred Summit — Guide
item.description: Mount Misen, the 535-metre peak that rises behind Itsukushima Shrine, is the sacred heart of Miyajima and the island’s finest walk. Revered for over a thousand years and covered in primeval forest, its trails climb through temples and past a hall holding a flame said to have burned continuously since the monk Kukai lit it in the ninth century — the same flame used to light the Flame of Peace in Hiroshima.
